headline: Brent Crude Falls on US-Iran Talks and Middle East Developments
summary: Brent crude futures fell 1.1%, extending previous losses amid diplomatic negotiations between the US and Iran and evolving Middle East conflict updates.
why: Brent crude is the leading global benchmark for oil prices, and geopolitical supply risks directly drive volatility in energy markets.
why_moved: Oil prices declined as diplomatic talks between the US and Iran signaled potential easing of geopolitical tensions and supply risks in the Middle East.
